meta.name: start-work
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan in Codex with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says start work, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Codex 中按计划自动执行多步骤工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Codex 中按计划自动执行多步骤工作流并支持中断恢复。
copy.tagline_en: Automate multi-step workflows in Codex from a plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically execute multi-step workflows in Codex from a plan with resume support.

howto.what: 装上后,当你说出执行计划的指令,Claude 会把工作拆成独立小任务,分派多个子代理并行完成,自己只做分派、检查和记录进度,不直接写代码;最后按计划核对完成情况。
howto.when: 当你说“开始工作”“执行计划”“继续计划”“恢复计划”,或要求运行 .omo/plans 里的计划时触发;一般发生在计划制定完成之后。

say.note: 它会读取计划并启动执行流程。
从上次未完成的检查点接着做。
指定计划文件后开始执行。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you give an instruction to execute a plan, Claude breaks the work into independent tasks, dispatches them to parallel subagents, and only handles dispatching, checking, and progress recording - it never writes code itself; then it verifies completion against the plan.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you say "start work", "execute plan", "continue plan", "resume plan", or ask to run a plan under .omo/plans; typically right after planning is done.

say_en.note: It will load the plan and start execution.
Resumes from the last unfinished checkpoint.
Specify the plan file and begin.
